source.title: Forum Digest (June 2022)
source.content:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA forum in the first half of 2022.

[**New Competitors should have extra time to register**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/new-competitors-should-have-extra-time-to-register/16915)
The community explains their experience regarding registering for competitions that fill up fast due to high demand and do not have extra time provision. Community members promote alternative ideas for registration, including allowing first time competitors priority or addressing the demand with more series competitions.

[**WCA Hall of Fame proposal**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-hall-of-fame/18293)
This is a proposed idea for having diplomas handed out to eminent and well accomplished cubers which include the cuber’s full list of achievements. This thread discusses whether currently active cubers should be included.

[**Sum of Ranks to win a competition**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/sum-of-ranks-to-win-a-competition/19158)
This thread proposes memory sports like result declaration where the competitor who gets the fastest results in many events, should be declared the overall winner of the competition.

[**Adding Team BLD as a WCA event**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/add-team-bld-as-an-official-event/18948)
This thread discusses the logistical issues with adding team BLD as an event. It would be the first team event in the WCA. The main concerns are how to ensure anti-cheating protocols and competitor pairing/ranking. 

[**Regulation changes effective from 1st June 2022**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-regulations-june-2022/21096)
The regulation change now implies that competitions do not need to have a mandatory Competitors Waiting Area. The safety rules restrictions at the competitions have also been relaxed by dropping article Y about temporary COVID regulations. 

[**2022 WR Summary**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/wca-records-results/11)
A total of 20 World Records were broken in the first half of 2022, with Max Park breaking 9 of those! A total of 13 World Records stand currently. Congrats to Max Park, Patrick Ponce, Zayn Khanani, Max Siauw, Sameer Agarwal, David Epstein, Jasper Murray, Simon Kellum, Juan Pablo Huanqui and Tommy Cherry.


If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

translation.title: WCA 论坛摘要（2022 年 6 月）
translation.content:
以下是 2022 年上半年 WCA 论坛上部分值得关注的话题。

[**新选手应获得额外报名时间**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/new-competitors-should-have-extra-time-to-register/16915)
社区成员分享了热门比赛名额很快报满、没有额外报名时间的经历，并提出其他报名方式，例如优先接纳首次参赛者，或通过增加系列赛来满足需求。

[**WCA 名人堂提案**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-hall-of-fame/18293)
有人提议向成绩卓著、贡献突出的魔友颁发证书，列出其全部成就。帖子讨论了是否应将仍在活跃参赛的魔友纳入其中。

[**用排名总和决定比赛总冠军**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/sum-of-ranks-to-win-a-competition/19158)
帖子提出采用类似记忆运动的成绩评定方式，将在多个项目中取得最快成绩的选手评为比赛总冠军。

[**将团队盲拧加入 WCA 正式项目**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/add-team-bld-as-an-official-event/18948)
帖子讨论了增设团队盲拧项目的组织问题。如果通过，它将成为 WCA 首个团队项目。主要顾虑是如何防作弊，以及如何安排选手配对和排名。

[**2022 年 6 月 1 日生效的规则修改**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wca-regulations-june-2022/21096)
规则修改后，比赛不再必须设置选手候场区。同时，删除新冠疫情临时规则的 Y 章，也放宽了比赛中的相关安全限制。

[**2022 年世界纪录汇总**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/c/wca-records-results/11)
2022 年上半年共打破 20 次世界纪录，其中 Max Park 一人贡献了 9 次！目前仍保持的有 13 项。祝贺 Max Park、Patrick Ponce、Zayn Khanani、Max Siauw、Sameer Agarwal、David Epstein、Jasper Murray、Simon Kellum、Juan Pablo Huanqui 和 Tommy Cherry。

如有疑问、意见或反馈，欢迎发邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
